## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] No login or account is required for the core workflow
- [ ] Career data remains user-controlled and local-first
- [ ] Imported resumes are not uploaded or retained on a Voca server
- [ ] Any new external service or AI transfer is optional and explicitly disclosed
- [ ] Invalid data, cancellation, errors and privacy boundaries are tested
- [ ] Unit/build and browser regression tests are included where appropriate
- [ ] Documentation and accessibility are considered
